source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: At the close of either turn, the player who just acted checks scoring first, followed by the other player. For each Secondary Mission whose conditions you first satisfied that turn, you can claim the listed VP. If you claim it for a Tactical Mission, discard that card. Then, on your own turn and only when using Tactical Missions, you may discard any number of active Secondary Missions for a single award of 1 CP if you discard at least one.

score.trigger: first meeting the conditions of a Secondary Mission that turn
